primary_reference.legal_basis: Human Medicines Regulations 2012, Schedule 20, Parts II and III

evidence_assessment.scope: UK internal-use herbal medicines: practitioner supply at or below 600 mg per dose and 1800 mg per day; above either threshold, registered-pharmacy supply under pharmacist supervision is required.
evidence_assessment.interpretation: Supply-channel restriction, not absolute dose prohibition.

issues_corrected: Removed overstatement that 600 mg/1800 mg are absolute maximum permitted doses.
Recorded pharmacy-supply pathway when thresholds are exceeded.
Documented internal use to Oral platform mapping.
